info.description: Application and agent integrations at api.useorlo.com. Authenticate with a runtime key scoped to one organization. Configure people-only actions in the Orlo console. Read the workflow guides at docs.useorlo.com/engineers.

trace_id.description: Request identifier when available; keep it for troubleshooting.

details.description: Error-specific context. VALIDATION_FAILED returns validation fields here, including status and entries. If a failed attempt also could not be recorded, evidence_recorded is false.

config.description: Task-level settings. On update, retain other config values; this field replaces the object. Response reuse applies to live requests immediately.

enabled.description: Opt into eligible exact-response reuse for up to five minutes. Prompt releases only, temperature 0–0.1, without sources, adapters or consensus.

skill_version_ids.description: Published skill version ids to pin, in order. Omit on update to keep the previous references; an empty array removes them.

config.description: Task-level settings. On update, retain other config values; this field replaces the object. Response reuse applies to live requests immediately.

enabled.description: Opt into eligible exact-response reuse for up to five minutes. Prompt releases only, temperature 0–0.1, without sources, adapters or consensus.

skill_version_ids.description: Published skill version ids to pin, in order. Omit on update to keep the previous references; an empty array removes them.

expected_version_id.description: The task version you edited. A changed version returns TASK_VERSION_CHANGED (409).

base_dataset_id.description: The latest dataset ID, or null when there is no dataset. Required for replace. A changed baseline returns DATASET_BASE_CHANGED (409).

redaction_warning.description: Present on a write when credential-like values changed. Inspect saved examples before comparing models.

redacted_sample_count.description: Number of new or copied samples changed by credential protection during this write.

retrieval_diagnostic.description: Requires a release test with two candidates using the same explicit model and task version, one with sources and one without; no deployment overrides. Both judges receive the same references.

evaluation_id.description: Optional comparison evidence. The task version and candidate must match, and the candidate must have produced usable results.

model.description: Accepted for client compatibility. The task release and routing settings select the model.

messages.description: Conversation data. Released task instructions and pinned skills always apply. Caller system, developer and tool messages become JSON-wrapped user data.

temperature.description: Overrides the release temperature. When neither specifies one, Orlo requests 0, matching comparisons.

max_completion_tokens.description: Output-token limit; takes precedence over max_tokens.

stream.description: Only complete answers are supported. true returns INVALID_INPUT (400) before a model call.

input.description: Task data, supplied separately from released instructions. {{field}} references name fields in this object.

deployment_id.description: Optional live release belonging to this task. Inactive releases return RELEASE_NOT_LIVE (409).

api_key.description: Provider secret. Stored encrypted and never returned by credential reads.

skill_versions.description: Exact published skill versions the agent loaded; verified by Orlo and recorded on the run.

action_id.description: Use this governed tool action ID for execution and business reports.

retrieval_diagnostic.description: Requires a release test with two candidates using the same explicit model and task version, one with sources and one without; no deployment overrides. Both judges receive the same references.

status.description: An indeterminate required check blocks the answer with abstain true, including under warn behavior.

output.description: Complete answer as a string, including when it contains JSON.

url_hint.description: Masked receiver address; the full URL and signing secret are not returned on reads.

ComparisonCandidate.description: A deployment supplies its own version and source setting; omit task_version_id and include_retrieval_context when supplying deployment_id. Two candidates may use the same model.

ArgumentCondition.description: Typed JSON Pointer comparison. Missing or incorrectly typed values are unknown; no coercion.

runtimeKey.description: Runtime key created by an admin in Settings → Keys. Each operation lists its required scope.
